resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package (e.g., PySCF or Psi4)

access.notes: Install via pip; provides MP2, geometry optimization, and frequency analysis.

resources.notes: Agent may choose any package that implements MP2 gradient and frequency calculations with the required basis sets.

resources.name: Basis Set Exchange

access.notes: May be used to obtain the Si basis set (McLean-Chandler) if not built into the QC package.

resources.notes: The 6-311G(d) basis for C is standard; the Si (12s,9p) contracted to [621111,52111] with d(0.450) can be retrieved from BSE or constructed manually.
